issues.issue: Does paragraph 97(1)(a) apply to the claim?
issues.result_text: Panel finds s.97(1)(a) does not apply on the evidence and analyses the claim under s.96 and 97(1)(b) only.

issues.issue: Does her fear as a single woman returning to Haiti establish a s.96 or 97 risk?
issues.applicant_position: She fears returning to Haiti alone as a single woman, with no one there and her daughter in Haiti.
issues.result_text: Her behaviour is inconsistent with that fear; she has family support and can arrange an airport pick-up.

issues.issue: Does personal risk from the 2015 and 2017 crimes, or being seen as having money after living abroad, establish refugee status?
issues.applicant_position: Lawyer argues she will be seen as having money after living in Canada, raising her risk on return.
issues.result_text: Random crimes are insufficient for personal risk; claimant is not a refugee under s.96 or 97(1)(b).
